fusions.name: Lulling Nudge
fusions.desc: A soft bump that deals 6 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Slow Current
fusions.desc: A rolling wash deals 10 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you and leaves them [Soaked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on them spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Drift Off
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbothered
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
